[{"Name":"DeAnn Robinson","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjUha-GuWrOjX_b2Rqe-Hunmsl9c10GCo21qmxVqxtviculpfOE=s120-c-rp-mo-ba12-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"When my boss launched his nonprofit, he decided he wanted to host a formal awards dinner for 200 people at the Library of Congress in Washington, DC. The only available date that year was just three months away. He thought that sounded great. I was less enthusiastic -- “utterly panicked” would be a more accurate description of my reaction.

We are based in Little Rock, Arkansas, and planning an event of that scale from a thousand miles away on such a tight timeline felt inconceivable to me. However, my boss spoke with a couple friends on the East Coast and both recommended Evoke as the firm in DC best capable of executing something this complex under those conditions.

I am very glad he listened - they were right.

Working with Jodi Moraru from Evoke was, without question, the most relaxing part of those three months for me. Anything Jodi handled was something I did not have to worry about. She knows everyone in DC, understands the venues inside and out, and worked absolute magic from start to finish.

She secured outstanding catering, stunning floral design, and a top-tier AV team. Her recommendations for both the photographer and the musician were spot-on. She knew exactly how the space needed to be transformed to feel elegant and seamless and brought in the right people to make that happen. She also handled countless details I would not even have known to anticipate.

Just as important, Jodi is incredibly calm. There were no crises, only quick pivots to well-considered backup plans she already had in place. I was overwhelmed more than once during the process, and Jodi consistently helped steady things and reduce the stress.

Jodi does not say “no” -- If something is impossible, she explains why and offers smart alternatives. If something is possible but ambitious, she tells you exactly what it will take and what it will cost. There are no false promises and no surprise expenses.

My favorite thing about working with Jodi is her well-placed confidence in her knowledge and expertise. She is not afraid to be direct, regardless of who the client is. When she tells you that you need something, you need it. Her only goal is to make the event exceptional, and she will not steer you wrong. She knows DC, she knows the people, and she knows the spaces. She does not pad the bill or add unnecessary elements. She genuinely wants your event to be spectacular and for you to be happy with the result.

Jodi and the team at Evoke guided us through two extremely successful awards dinners at the Jefferson Library and are currently helping us plan our third (much larger) annual awards dinner at the Mellon this spring. As both a bride and an industry professional with over a decade of experience in hospitality, many assumed I would neither want nor require a wedding planner. That assumption could not have been more wrong. Knowing the time, care, and precision required to plan a wedding, I knew that if I hoped to maintain my sanity and enjoy the year ahead, help from an expert was essential.

After speaking with three planners, Julie stood out as an immediate and resounding yes. She is calm, reassuring, and sincerely caring, while remaining professional. She possesses an innate ability to listen and translate personal stories into thoughtful, meaningful design. Julie took the unique elements of my husband’s and my relationship and wove them seamlessly into every aspect of our wedding day, resulting in an event that felt deeply personal and authentically reflective of who we are.

It may seem like a large upfront cost, but paid off tremendously over the course of the planning process and saved us 100s of hours of our own time and worry.

Jessica, Sarah, and the team are hands down amazing. They orchestrated a seamless, low-stress, and memorable wedding weekend for us. In particular, JAE:

- Designed a cohesive, beautiful, and very “us” aesthetic for our wedding and Sunday brunch send-off events. The team took our feedback and iterations well, and the final result was stunning!
- Listened to and concentrated on our priorities, which were “guest experience” and “easy on our families” (i.e. good logistics). Jessica led with this in every call and clearly prioritized what we asked for throughout the process.
- Communicated proactively and professionally throughout the entire 18 months, to include constant email communications and regular video conferences (weekly as of a month out). Jessica never made us feel rushed during these check-ins and always took the time to fully answer our questions.
- Introduced us to and facilitated top-notch vendor connections that we otherwise would not have found or had access to. JAE and their preferred vendors work together like a well-oiled machine, and our stress levels were very low as a result! We had full faith in Jessica’s recommendations, and our vendors delivered!
- Advocated for us and always had our best intentions - and budget - as their priorities. We truly felt JAE was “in our corner” and not “just” doing business with us. JAE was invested and wanted to achieve our vision for the wedding. We completely trusted Jessica’s recommendations and guidance, which helped create a smooth, fun weekend.
- Delivered masterful logistics: Sarah and Jessica crushed all logistics, from the shuttle schedules to vendor management on the day-of, to timing and more. For me, their spot-on organization and logistics are the X-factor that make JAE great. When you hire JAE, you will never have to sweat the small details, as the team has it all covered. They make otherwise extremely difficult situations (e.g., inclement weather, last minute RSVPs, vendor turn-over, etc.) incredibly easy, which allowed us to focus on each other and our guests. Not having to worry about what was happening behind the scenes on our wedding day (e.g., vendor staging, handing out tip money, ensuring shuttles were on time, who has the rings, etc.) was tremendous.

We highly recommend working with a planner from start to finish, and JAE is THE planner to work with in the DC/VA/MD area. Our wedding would not have been nearly as beautiful, effortless, and enjoyable had we not worked with them. From the very first conversation, it was clear that Andrew wasn’t just a planner, he’s a visionary, a storyteller, and a deeply thoughtful collaborator. He took the time to understand who Donald and I are as individuals and as a couple, and he transformed that understanding into an experience that exceeded anything we could have dreamed.

What stood out most was Andrew’s intentionality. Every detail, no matter how small, had meaning. Every decision was made with purpose. He anticipated needs we didn’t even know we had and guided us with a perfect balance of expertise, creativity, and calm reassurance. His communication was seamless: clear, consistent, and always grounded in care. We never once felt lost or overwhelmed because Andrew held every piece with such confidence and clarity.

And then came the execution. Our wedding was breathtaking. Truly breathtaking.

From the moment we walked into the venue, we were stunned. The floral arrangements were lush and elegant, the candles created the most romantic glow, and the décor felt like stepping into a world crafted entirely for us. Every transition, every room, every element was orchestrated with precision and artistry. Friends and family are still talking about how beautiful and seamless everything felt; and that is 100% because of Andrew.

He didn’t just plan our wedding. He brought our love story to life. He honored our vision and elevated it. He created a space where we felt celebrated, seen, and completely held. What Andrew delivered wasn’t simply an event — it was an experience, a memory we will carry for the rest of our lives.

If you want a planner who is thoughtful, communicative, imaginative, meticulous, and genuinely invested in your joy, there is no one like Andrew Roby. user_reviews:
[{"Name":"Symone Mercado","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocI0VCVXchlesr0qILgG-ox76DLckE7gftPofOXkT9Aq48O2Gw=s120-c-rp-mo-ba12-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Stephanie truly went above and beyond in every possible way to make my brother and his fiancée’s wedding an absolutely unforgettable experience!

From the moment she joined the planning process, Stephanie elevated everything. She immediately took the couple’s vision and brought it to life in such a thoughtful, organized, and meaningful way. Her recommendations were spot-on at every step, and she approached each detail with both creativity and expertise. She ensured all vendors, timelines, and design elements were fully aligned, creating a seamless plan that carried effortlessly into an absolutely flawless wedding day that exceeded everyone’s expectations!

When we had to pivot due to weather and move the entire ceremony indoors, Stephanie was already ahead of it. The transition was so smooth and flawlessly executed that multiple guests told us they didn’t even realize the ceremony was originally supposed to be outside—they thought it had always been planned that way. That alone speaks volumes about her preparation, leadership, and ability to execute under pressure and adapt in real time.

What stood out most about Stephanie is her attention to detail. She is incredibly organized, proactive, and genuinely thinks of everything—from décor execution to timing to the smallest logistical touches that make a wedding feel effortless. Nothing slips through the cracks with her!!

Her assistant, Ibti, was also amazing and added such a strong day-of support system. Together they made sure everything ran smoothly, even jumping in to help with last-minute needs (including running to the store to restock the bar so the celebration never skipped a beat).

From ceremony execution to reception flow to the grand sparkler exit, everything was handled beautifully. The entire day felt seamless, stress-free, and fully present for the couple—which is exactly what every family hopes for on a wedding day.

Stephanie and her team truly take away the stress and replace it with confidence. Whether you are in full planning mode or need support closer to the finish line, she knows how to take your vision and elevate it into something intentional, organized, and unforgettable!

From the consultation and throughout the entire process Kristy was lovely to work with and incredibly friendly and personal but also always on top of everything. She flagged so many little details that we never would have thought of but led to a much smoother wedding day. Her detailed resources, templates, and documents were invaluable, but she was also flexible when I needed to make my own spreadsheets to keep everything straight in a way that worked with my brain.

The timeline she created for us was a work of art and a thing of beauty and something I could have never done on my own. She included every single facet of the event from load in and load out for every vendor down to when we needed to bring our checkbook. Handing communications with vendors to her team in the last few months was amazing and definitely reduced our stress levels. While the timeline was delayed (due to another vendor), Kristy pivoted quickly and ensured that things got back on track and as close to the plan as possible. When we changed our mind on things mid-wedding (like if we wanted a more formal send off) she ensured that it was actually what we wanted but then changed to accommodate it. If you’re looking for something festive that shows off DC in a completely different way, this is worth considering.

Food and Drinks

They offer a holiday dinner menu that may shift depending on whether you go around Thanksgiving, Christmas, or New Year’s. Here’s what I tried:

Blue Crab and Potato Chowder - Good.

Pan-Seared Chicken Breast - mambo sauce, a true DC tradition, absolutely slapped.

Orange Olive Oil Cake - flavorful without being overpoweringly citrusy.

Before we set sail, I had the chance to try shrimp wontons and mini beef Wellington bites. I was with a special group, so I don’t know if these are typically offered and I wouldn’t count on it being a standard part of the experience. The bar selection on board was also very good and had plenty of options.

To set expectations, this is not meant to be a fine-dining, award-winning chef situation, though the food is solid and enjoyable. You are not going on this cruise primarily for the food.

Atmosphere and Experience

The real highlight is the atmosphere. The views of DC at night from the water are stunning, with monuments and bridges lit up around you. It feels festive, peaceful, and special, especially during the holiday season.

This is a great option if you have family visiting or you just want to do something unique for the holidays. It’s a fun change of pace from the usual seasonal activities and a memorable way to enjoy the city.

Overall

It is easily one of the most immersive and interactive museums in the city.
​The Highlights
​The museum does an incredible job of making you feel like part of the action. From the moment you receive your Undercover Mission badge, you are tracked throughout the exhibits, testing your skills at surveillance, disguise, and code-breaking. The collection of artifacts is world-class—ranging from cold-war era "suicide needles" to actual props from the James Bond films. The storytelling is top-tier, blending pop culture fun with the sobering realities of real-world intelligence work.
​The Challenges
​While the content is five-star, the logistics can be a bit of a mission in themselves:
​Large Crowds: This is a very popular destination for school field trips. During my visit, there were several large groups of high school students arriving by the busload. This can make the more narrow gallery spaces feel quite cramped and noisy.
​Long Waits: Because the exhibits are so interactive, bottle-necks are common. You should expect significant wait times to use the digital kiosks or participate in the "testing" stations.
​Pro-Tip
​To avoid the heaviest "bus traffic," try to book your tickets for a late afternoon weekday or right at opening. If you see a large group of students ahead of you, it might be worth slowing down in the current gallery to let the crowd clear before moving to the next interactive station.
​Overall, it’s a brilliant, high-energy experience that is well worth the ticket price—just bring a little extra patience for the On July 29, 2026, I met with Closet America sales representative Samantha Slagle regarding a new closet system and shelving for my pantry. I explained from the beginning that I was initially looking for an estimate because I planned to have wood flooring installed and thought I should wait until the flooring was completed before moving forward with the closet.

Samantha specifically told me that I did not need to wait. She assured me that I could have the closet installed first and that my flooring installers would be able to work around the closet system afterward. Because this was an important concern, I asked her again if she was certain. She confirmed that, yes, the flooring installers would definitely be able to work around the new closet. Based on that representation, I decided to move forward with Closet America.

Approximately one week before installation, Samantha called and asked whether I had installed the wood flooring yet. I told her no and reminded her that she had told me the flooring could be installed after the closet because the flooring installers could work around it. I specifically asked whether there was a problem, and she told me everything was fine and that she was simply confirming.

Unfortunately, once the closet was installed, I was told something completely different. The installer informed me that the wood flooring could not simply be installed around the closet as I had been told. Instead, I would need to contact Closet America to have the bottom portion of the closet removed before the flooring could be installed—and I would be charged an additional fee for them to come back and do so.

This was extremely frustrating because the timing of the flooring installation was discussed before I signed the contract, and I relied on the information provided by the sales representative when deciding to move forward.

I was also very uncomfortable with one of the installers who entered my home because there was an extremely strong odor that smelled like marijuana. Regardless of the cause, having a contractor enter my residence with such a strong odor as if he had just left a marijuana dispensary was concerning and did not feel professional at all!

Even more disappointing is the actual closet design. After spending money on a custom closet system, I literally have less usable space than I had before. I cannot properly fit the clothing and shoes that were previously stored in the closet. In my opinion, the space was mismeasured, poorly planned, or seriously misjudged during the design process. A custom closet should improve storage and functionality—not leave the customer wondering where to put belongings that fit in the closet before the renovation.

I contacted customer service regarding these issues and was told that someone would call me back. No one did.

[{"Name":"Rachel and McPhail","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocKtl9mlNKdCyyBDT610Ot7FmH1O4smRQYC4BUJRwjOxxcjYVA=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Planning a wedding from halfway across the world would not have been possible without Kolena and she really showed us what a difference a good planner can make for your wedding. Our priority was to make things simple and easy for guests, and we chose Kolena because her approach aligned with that goal.
From the beginning, she really helped make the vendor selection process easy and, as someone who frequently gets overwhelmed by choices, it gave us peace of mind knowing someone in the industry had experience with and could vouch for the various vendors we considered. Kolena also helped us make tradeoffs to get what we really wanted for our wedding and cut costs where we could to stay within our budget range. We both felt really relaxed throughout the whole planning process, most often asking if there was anything more we should be doing but Kolena always had everything handled (even with an 8+ hour time difference!).

Kolena also has a great eye for design and attention to detail. We got so many compliments from guests on how beautiful our wedding details were - it was all thanks to her.

We really realized how amazing Kolena was at her job the day after our wedding, when we were reflecting on the best parts of the day. Our Wedding day went smoothly, and Kolena took care of all of the small details that we might not have thought of. Catering staff followed us around cocktail hour to ensure we got to eat plenty of the food we'd selected. The polaroid cameras we used for our guestbook were never out of film. We had not asked for any of these things and yet Kolena made it all happen. title: Brianne McMullan Events LLC
user_reviews:
[{"Name":"Holly Lang","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjV81RcNLgmHH0KpI9XDvsiKStbMgIXeDHgYdXV6RQKVABf3Hb9X=s120-c-rp-mo-ba12-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Brides (and Grooms) – if you’re looking for a planner who is not only knowledgeable and organized but also kind beyond measure and willing to go above and beyond for you to have the most perfect wedding day, Brianne is your girl!! In short, Brianne and her team made our wedding day everything we could have imagined even while she was pregnant and through the ups and downs of covid. We would have never made it without her, and I will tell anyone who listens how worthwhile of an investment her services are. I’ve included a detailed review below if you want to keep reading but if you want the quick take – do yourself a favor and hire Brianne!! You will actually enjoy the wedding planning process and will arrive at your big day confident that it will be everything you dreamed and more!!!

We began planning for our September 2020 wedding in July of 2019, well before covid was even a thought. We interviewed several planners and Brianne immediately stood out – as mentioned before, she was exceedingly kind and not only listened to the (honestly, fragmented) ideas we had for our day but sounded excited about them and made us feel like they were accomplishable with our budget. We chose to go with Brianne’s full-service planning which includes design, planning and execution and it was the BEST. DECISION. EVER.

Her design process was able to capture all our seemingly random wants and put them into the vision we didn’t even know we had. When she presented the design plan to us, we were so impressed, and it was so in line with what we were looking for that I am pretty sure we only ended up changing the napkins. Brianne toured venues with us, attended wedding band previews and even arranged/ joined my wedding dress shopping days. We started working to secure the design-related vendors right when lockdowns began, and it was nerve-wracking to think about out how we were supposed to navigate our way forward. But Brianne stepped up and made us feel like she didn’t even miss a beat. She coordinated with vendors for virtual meetings and worked with them outside of our time to ensure they were in line with our design/ vision. She answered my never-ending stream of questions via email and was always prepared to explain the pros & cons of every situation/ design choice. When our venue wouldn’t allow us to do one of the things we wanted to for our design, she worked closely with our florist and turned the situation into one that we loved.

With coivd in play, there was always a possibility of us having to change our date and there were several other precautions we had to take into account throughout the planning process. Brianne managed all of this with grace and steadiness, she kept us clearly informed about what the options were, how the vendors would react and how it would impact us. She helped us address coivd concerns with our guests while making sure it wasn’t at the forefront of our day.

The last few weeks leading to the wedding were smooth and enjoyable thanks to the work Brianne puts in to coordinate all the final details. I was so relaxed and was truly able to enjoy our wedding week with friends and family. The day of the wedding was so well coordinated and easy – I didn’t stress at all. We were blown away when we finally got to see the ceremony and reception spaces – the colors, flowers and every single element were intentional and perfect. We had been watching the weather all day and it was set to rain right at ceremony time (of course) – Brianne had a plan though and, because she knew I was determined to have an outdoor ceremony, helped us get started a few minutes early to make that happen. We even had a power outage during the reception, and she worked with the venue and other vendors to resolve the situation and even extend our night a bit! We, along with our guests, were so in love with the design elements and execution of the day that we talked non-stop about it for months. Brianne truly made our wishes come true and made our engagement year one that was enjoyable and fun!

[{"Name":"Devon","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocLgsScvCOFr3s0YyKwrpzDOoJsMP6fpdkukogVDBCPddyryJw=s120-c-rp-mo-ba12-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"We could not have asked for a better planning, floral, and décor partner than Weddings by Epic.

After being highly recommended by our venue, I first connected with Jenn (owner) and immediately hit it off. What was supposed to be a quick intro call turned into an hour-long conversation about goals, budgets, vendors, and vision. Jenn is incredibly knowledgeable—not just about the wedding industry, but about the ins and outs of our venue—which gave me confidence as an out-of-town bride building the right team within budget to execute a timeless, elegant, chic wedding. Because weddings are so subjective, I cared deeply about aesthetic alignment. Jenn immediately understood the elevated, refined direction we envisioned and demonstrated that Weddings by Epic can execute across a wide range of styles at a very high level.

We chose their “month-of coordination” package (which actually began about six months out), and it was perfect for us. With a short engagement and significant vendor outreach already completed, I wanted an expert partner to pull everything together. Jenn and her team were always available for questions and thoughtful solutions. Everyone on her team contributed valuable suggestions—especially Aubree, Courtney, and Jessica.

We also hired Weddings by Epic for florals and décor, and I’m so glad we kept everything under one roof. Fewer vendors meant full alignment across teams, transparent pricing, and true ownership over the final outcome. Their floral pricing was also very reasonable compared to other quotes we received.

Coming from a creative and production background, I’m very detail-oriented, yet Jenn and her team suggested elements I hadn’t considered. Their checklist and Aisle Planner tool were extremely helpful, especially for the seating chart and floor plan—they even had the venue layout pre-loaded. Visiting their showroom to see flowers, candles, and vessels in person helped me fully visualize the design. Jessica, Design Manager, executed the florals and décor beautifully and guided us through every detail. Jenn helped us prioritize and was honest about where to splurge or save. One thing I'll never forget: I had chosen white garden roses due to seasonality and budget, but Jenn surprised me with a white peony bouquet on the wedding day.

Courtney, our dedicated planner, was phenomenal. She was responsive via email and text and thorough on each call. On the wedding day, she and her assistant Allison executed everything flawlessly. My husband, our families, and I were all so happy with how smoothly the day ran. Courtney helped bustle my dress, kept the timeline on track, and handled countless behind-the-scenes details—including tracking down Polaroid guest book photos so nothing was lost.

But after deciding we wanted our wedding to be beyond grand - a guest tailored, next level experience, we knew we needed guidance. RHS Events, Hailey, is the only one who could achieve this vision.

Hailey was involved in every facet, in every little detail of our big day. Not only is she prepared with the skills to make every little moment perfect, but she gives you, the couple, the tools to bring your own vision to life. When we could not picture a Sangeet theme, Hailey took down our general vibe through meetings and developed a masterpiece of design in deep reds and olive green. Hailey painted us a picture of each event, what all it entailed and every step we needed to fulfill to make it the best it could be. Whether we were filling out our program orders or deciding what songs to play down the aisle, Hailey never missed a beat. Further, Hailey’s ability to navigate all differing opinions is unmatched. She knows how to give everyone want they want, and leave everyone feeling heard. Even when our views directly opposed the wants of our parents, we left every meeting feeling like we had a game plan where we were all on board.

Our wedding weekend was beyond our wildest dreams. Hailey and her team made every dream come true through her careful planning and exact execution. Hailey’s team knew every detail, every timeline and ran the entire event like a well-oiled machine. When our wedding weekend came and the weather threatened to change our experience, Hailey was prepared with backup plans and executed them perfectly. Even in the little moments, we felt taken care of. One of her staff members, Lulu, was always there with Umber, making sure she was on time, and always had whatever she needed. Her attention to Umber’s needs made the whole weekend even more relaxed. We were able to fully enjoy every moment of our wedding weekend because we had no doubt, come what may, Hailey and the RHS team had it handled.

As a type A bride with a very particular dream of her wedding, Umber always worried about her high expectations versus reality. Hailey made all of her dreams come true. No phones while she walked down the aisle, a nearly silent audience during the ceremony and the most smooth and elevated wedding experience we could ever imagine.

If you want to take some of the burden off of your shoulders and have an organized wedding, get a wedding planner. If you want the most tailored, seamlessly planned weekend of your life, that people will talk about for years and years to come, hire Hailey and the RHS team.

Thank you so much Hailey for allowing us to be present at our wedding and a weekend we will never forget.

- Charles & Umber [{"Name":"Sharon Miller","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocKOa7Hg8bb7hc_67SwLjcqkxlc7PblLqFFVodhpFakYj2QdhA=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Best Destination Wedding Planner in Atlanta, Georgia
My husband and I were wed on April 9, 2016 in La Jolla California and it will be a day we never forget. When Lance and I first started to discuss how we wanted to put together an unforgettable wedding, immediately we decided on a destination wedding, residing in Dallas, Georgia, we did not have many options on venues for a beautiful wedding.
We chose La Jolla California for many reasons, the beautiful scenery, the people always being so nice and most of all, it was were we first vacationed together as a couple. Right away I become over whelmed. Where should we have our wedding? Where do I buy flowers? How will I know what everything will look like from so far away? Where do I go to buy certain items we need for the wedding? The list goes on and on...I knew right away I needed a wedding planner.
We searched the Internet for companies in the area but were surprised to find that A Corporate Event & Weddings  had a BBB account, not only an account but an A+ rating, no questions asked, we called Kindall and I IMMEDIATELY felt at ease and the weight of the wedding world had come off my shoulders. The very fist time I talked to Kindall she made me feel like she had dropped EVERYTHING she was doing to cater to me and make sure I was at ease that the wedding planning was already taken care of.
We hired A Corporate Event & Weddings  in January, 3 months before our wedding and the entire time we planned our wedding with Kindall it was such a pleasant experience. She truly went out of her way to make sure I knew exactly what I was getting, what the venue was like, what it looked like and every single detail of the entire day. The biggest part that helped us was that Kindall already knew a ton of vendors and she knew which ones fit our needs and budget. She eliminated the need to interview and research every single vendor that is needed for a wedding, which I imagine could take months to do!
The day of the wedding A Corporate Event & Weddings  went into overdrive! Josey, the unforgettable mommy to be, was in and out of my room all day delivering items, checking on me, making sure I was calm and always had something nice to say every time I opened the door the let her in. Kindall, as busy as she was transforming the La Valencia Ballroom to a magical dream come true wedding site, called me constantly just to say "Hi" or "Is everything okay?" That alone made me feel like I was the ONLY bride she had and she truly and honestly cared for me and my husband on our wedding day.
When I first walked into the venue, (trying to hide from my soon to be hubby) I cried. It looked like something out of a magazine and I could not believe it had all been done for us, little ole us from Dallas, Georgia it was a moment I will never forget. The flowers were so amazingly beautiful just like I envisioned. The linens hung ever so gracefully, the diamonds and sparkles shined like the lights were focused on just that, the center pieces were something I had only seen on TV (David Tutera type stuff!) Kindall and I had previously discussed a adding a detail that was later not needed but she used the material to make private cabanas instead which added such an intimate touch. Any other wedding planner I am sure would have just chalked that up as a loss and just said they didn't need the material anymore, even already paid for.
The ceremony site was another dream come true. When I walked down the aisle on a custom made beautiful aisle runner along side color coordinating orchids in beautifully placed glass vases I still couldn't believe my eyes. When I finally reached my husband underneath the custom made chuppah with beautifully flowing drapery and a chandelier (still in amazement) it finally hit me that Kindall was the BEST and none of these dreamed visions would have came true with out HER!
I felt like I had not only hired a wedding planner but a friend to hold my hand through it all, from the beginning to the end.
Sharon and Lance Miller

[{"Name":"Kayla Feng","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjWx79cNXa9m_UqT1HZZVpMiCpdPasCFSLbhjJhlTEOwrKb4aTRa=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"I worked with Hannah for nearly two years on our wedding ceremony and reception. By the end of the process, she felt more like a trusted teammate than a wedding planner. She has an incredible ability to balance kindness and empathy with decisiveness and honesty—something I desperately needed whenever I became overwhelmed by the endless decisions that come with planning a wedding.

One of the best decisions we made was trusting her recommendations. We used every vendor she suggested (with the exception of our photographer), and every single one exceeded our expectations. It also spoke volumes that every vendor genuinely loved working with her. They consistently commented on how calm, organized, and steady she is under pressure. She even encouraged us to invest a little more thought into our linens—something I never would have considered—and it completely elevated the look of our reception without dramatically increasing our budget.

As the wedding approached, Hannah flawlessly managed every moving piece behind the scenes. She made sure every invoice was paid, coordinated directly with our lion dancers, kept vendors on schedule, and proactively solved problems before they ever reached us. When hair and makeup ran behind, she calmly adjusted the timeline, coordinated our families, and suggested an impromptu first look that ended up becoming one of our favorite memories from the entire day.

Throughout the wedding, she handled countless details I didn't even realize needed attention. She held onto my phone, bustled my dress, checked in when unexpected guests arrived, and even quietly made sure everyone was wearing shoes after a glass shattered on the dance floor. I'm certain there were dozens of other fires she put out that day—I just never heard about them because she handled everything so seamlessly.

Perhaps the greatest gift Hannah gave us was peace of mind. She repeatedly reminded my mom that watching the clock wasn't her job anymore—it was Hannah's. That simple reassurance allowed our families to be fully present and actually enjoy the day we'd spent two years planning. I never once worried about what was happening next because I knew Hannah had it handled.

If you're looking for someone who will not only execute your vision but also become a calm, trusted advocate throughout one of the biggest days of your life, I cannot recommend Hannah highly enough. She is thoughtful, organized, deeply caring, and exceptionally talented. At the end of the day, I would highly recommend staying away from this event especially if you are Black or brown, they don't care about you unless you're up on that stage performing.

The hotel itself is a beautiful historic landmark. The lobby and the Golden Ballroom are absolutely stunning and full of old‑world charm. You can feel the history the moment you walk in.

During my first stay in August and September of 2025, I had a lakefront room in the North Tower. The room was bright, clean, and comfortable. The bathroom definitely showed its age, but it was clean and functional.

On my most recent visit in May 2026, I stayed in a non‑view room in the South Tower, and the bathroom had just been fully renovated. It was a huge upgrade and genuinely very nice. The room itself had the same furnishings as my previous stay, and while they are not brand new, they feel current and well kept. The renovated bathroom made a huge difference. The hallway on that floor had also been redone and looked noticeably fresher than some of the other floors I passed in the elevator, so it seems like renovations are happening floor by floor.

The beds and pillows were great, and I slept wonderfully each night of both visits, which is sometimes hard in hotels, so major kudos on that. The TV is not huge, but I do not come to Chicago to watch TV in the room anyway.

The location is truly fantastic. It is right by the iconic Buckingham (Married with Children) Fountain and within easy walking distance of museums, parks, public transit, and tons of dining and shopping options. It is a great base for exploring the city and feels extremely safe.

Every staff member I interacted with was friendly and helpful, especially the guys at the door all day and night, which I really appreciated.

A few things to note that could be improved:

• The rooms do not have individual temperature controls. I prefer a colder room, and while it was not quite summer yet so it was not a major issue, it is something to be aware of. I will probably bring my travel fan if I go back during the summer.

• The window coverings could use an update. My room only had drapes with no blackout option and no sheers. The drapes dim the room, but without sheers I did not feel comfortable opening them since my window faced other rooms across the way. Adding sheers would make a big difference in comfort and privacy.

• Some of the displays in the common areas could use refreshing. The display advertising events and weddings looks like it is from the mid‑80s and does not really showcase the hotel’s potential. A few of the street‑facing windows and displays could also use some updating to give the hotel more curb appeal.

These are all things that can be fixed, and just from one visit to the next I saw major improvements, so I am really hopeful this wonderful place will have its renaissance.

Overall, the Congress Plaza is a historic gem that is clearly in the process of being refreshed. The renovated areas show a lot of promise, and I hope the updates continue so more of the hotel can shine the way it was intended to. It is a unique place to stay with an unbeatable location, especially if you appreciate classic architecture and do not mind a mix of old and new. I would not recommend her.","text_translated":"","reply_text_original":"Heather, for some reason we weren’t notified of your review and noticed it today -- exactly a year since the pandemic began and rocked the wedding world as we knew it. We’re honestly quite surprised considering we had chatted via phone after the wedding. But, we are happy to address these concerns.
We’d first like to clarify that you initially hired our company for Coordination services (not as your Planner, as stated in your review). Eventually, we assisted with some planning with some of your vendors when you began to have a hard time in the process, and also assisted you by managing florals.
For context, your wedding took place on 8/22/2020 and, while we’re honored to have been a part of it, this was at a time where COVID-19 cases were up and down in Florida. For this reason, your venue required that all vendors AND guests sign COVID-19 liability releases (meaning they’d allow the event to take place but would not be held responsible for any illness/death).
When this was decided, we advised you we had no issue signing this document and we would uphold the services within your contract as best allowable under the circumstances (without risking our lives and the lives of our families in contracting COVID-19). I specifically recall on various occasions mentioning to you my mother’s medical conditions that put her at a high risk of severe illness/death. You always seemed to understand this.
Your (indoor) ceremony location allowed your guests to enter/remain without masks. The ceremony was approximately 35 minutes away from the (indoor) reception venue, which allowed guests to remove their masks upon entering the main reception area, per your request. This meant myself, my assistant, and all vendors would be exposed to your 100 unmasked guests. Social distancing would only be possible up until guests joined the dance floor. Prior to your ceremony it was agreed that the church’s ceremony coordinators included within their ceremony services would manage the ceremony accordingly so that we (35 minutes away) could manage your cocktail hour and reception setup at the hotel. At no point was any change to this discussed. Moreover, your photographer was the only vendor that did not agree to sign the COVID waiver, was too concerned for her health to attend, and sent a replacement photography team. This was agreed to by you and if that team did not seamlessly manage your photos, it would be unfair to fault us for their experience or lack thereof. Your ceremony musician canceled due to COVID.
Nevertheless, upon your family/wedding party’s tardy arrival, we remained distanced, I quickly introduced myself to the room and advised that introductions would begin soon. Rehearsal was not attended because having worked with ceremony location this is a) something they cover, b) was not requested by you in your services with us, and c) masks would not be worn by all. If there was a feeling of lack of presence it is because we did our very best to maintain distance as all guests were unmasked. Our goal was to limit exposure, especially knowing some of your guests had traveled.
One of those traveling guests was your sister who was very inebriated. Before dancing began, we (as agreed) allowed the band to take over with the reception before departing (this is not typically what takes place as we remain for the reception and event breakdown until the last guest/vendors depart, but given the circumstances and to protect mine and my family’s health, in a very active pandemic, this was the course of action). Your sister then followed me outside to the valet and became loud and belligerent, yelling/cursing at me less than a foot away in front of other hotel guests/staff. This, even if intoxicated, is inexcusable behavior (covered in our contract’s abuse clause).
Overall we are saddened that given the overarching situation around the day/year, and all efforts made, you left this review without all facts considered. Hiring a wedding planner was an “engagement gift” from my husband so that I could enjoy our time engaged and not stress over every detail of the wedding planning process. This was the BEST decision that we made and I truly think if we didn’t have Amanda we would have cancelled the wedding and eloped at least twice. From the very first phone call with her we knew that Amanda was the clear choice. Amanda has an incredibly calming presence and listened to everything that we said over the phone while also speaking in a way that let us know she knew exactly how to make our wedding the best day ever. Throughout the entire time working with her she answered every email or text incredibly quickly, followed up consistently with us, made sure to keep our budget in mind when suggesting vendors, and handled all of our vendor and contract questions. Even though we hired Amanda for only partial planning, she offered to be on every vendor call if needed and helped field a variety of vendor questions throughout the year or so we were planning. Although she is the expert, Amanda does an amazing job of letting you plan your wedding. She always gave us all of our options, gave pros/cons, and gave guidance however we never felt swayed one way or another to make a choice unless we explicitly asked her to make the decision. Even if this meant talking through something and changing my mind 30 times she stayed patient and let us talk through everything with her until we were 100% confident in the decision, no matter how big or small that was. Amanda is BOOKED, like all the time booked (as she should be!!), however her attention and dedication to each client made us feel like we were her ONLY client. We had a particularly tough vendor situation come up and Amanda set up a call with us immediately, talking through the new game plan and reassured us that the issue was going to be a non-issue because she had it handled. She requested to be copied on all email correspondences and helped smooth out the issue better than anyone else could have. On the day of our wedding, Amanda made sure that everything ran beyond smoothly. She kept us within our timeline and reassured me throughout the day with any questions I had. My only regret on our wedding was that we didn’t get more pictures with Amanda because she truly made our day unforgettable. Ashley and B Eventful truly saved our wedding day from what could have been a disaster after we finally realized, only weeks before the wedding, that the coordinator that we previously hired for “month of” service had accomplished absolutely nothing towards organizing the event. Based on a recommendation, we reached out to Ashley in full panic mode about needing to change coordinators and hired her only TWELVE days before our wedding. She recognized that it would be a lot of work and an incredibly short turnaround, but she was confident in her ability to execute, and the moment we hired her, she sprung into action immediately, reaching out to our vendors, gathering as many details as possible, and compiling and documenting everything into the portal which was shared with us.

We very quickly saw her incredible level of organization, thoroughness, and attention to detail. She spent several long late night calls with us hashing out every detail, many of which we never considered,  and developed a meticulous timeline for the day from start to finish. She orchestrated the layout for the entire venue, helped work out our seating chart, and ironed out all the final details with vendors from their arrival time, breakdown/ pickup time, any special requirements they had, and she even reviewed all of the contracts to advise which vendors had already included gratuity and which were expected to be paid later. After working with her for only a few days, we felt all of our planning stress start to disappear.

The morning before the wedding, Ashley organized our on-site rehearsal and made sure our entire wedding party and family understood the flow of the ceremony and their roles. She took the time to learn everyone’s names and collect all their contact information to keep in communication the day of.

The day of the wedding, Ashley arrived at the venue at 10am to oversee the delivery of our rentals, and with the help of her assistant, Megan, spent the entire day tirelessly setting up décor, directing vendors, trouble shooting, and problem solving. If there were any issues, we were never aware, and she handled them quickly and professionally. She even took the time to run out mid reception to buy more prosecco for my husband after she learned that the bartenders had mistakenly served it all to guests. The next day, she provided us with a full Google share of video clips and photos she’d taken throughout the day which was so thoughtful and amazing to have, especially considering we didn’t hire videography.

Our day turned out absolutely beautifully, and it is undeniably owed in no small part to Ashley and B Eventful. She made my vision come to life and our guests raved about every detail from the venue, to the ceremony, food, and décor. I honestly don’t know where we would’ve been without Ashley and all of her hard work, and on top of that, she is truly a just delight to work with. She understood the stress we’d been under and was able to turn it all around with such care, kindness, and professionalism. Our only regret is that we didn’t hire her sooner! [{"Name":"Frank & Brianna","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjXuTpg61OSvEzx0NTttP-rm-7-bxyCv-n6me9NbEqAagvrLP58=s120-c-rp-mo-ba12-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"My husband Frank and I truly cannot imagine our wedding day without Melissa and Be Younique Events. After working with her for over a year, we can confidently say she is one of the most genuine, talented, organized, and thoughtful people we have ever met.

From the very beginning, Melissa made us feel completely taken care of. She is incredibly professional and exceptionally organized, but never in a way that feels cold or overwhelming. She has such a calm, reassuring presence, and throughout the entire planning process, she made everything feel seamless and manageable.

What amazed us most was her ability to bring together so many unique elements, vendors, and design ideas into one cohesive masterpiece. Every detail flowed together perfectly — from the florals in my hair, to the cake flowers, to the tablescapes, arbor, and décor. Everything felt intentional, elevated, and beautifully connected. It was beyond anything we could have imagined.

Melissa also gifted us custom graphic design elements for our tablescape and table numbers, which was such an incredibly thoughtful touch. She tied in elements of our Italian heritage in such a beautiful and tasteful way, and it made the entire experience feel even more personal and meaningful.

Her timeline execution was flawless. If any issues or hiccups came up behind the scenes, we genuinely had no idea because she handled everything with such professionalism and grace. We were fully able to enjoy our wedding day because we trusted her completely.

She also connected us with some of the best vendors we have ever worked with. We had already selected a few vendors before meeting her, but she perfectly filled in the gaps with incredible recommendations for florals, rentals, entertainment, and more. Every recommendation she made exceeded expectations.

One of the sweetest moments was Melissa helping us learn and practice our aisle dip before the ceremony. It may seem like a small detail, but it perfectly reflects the kind of planner she is - thoughtful, encouraging, hands-on and fully invested in creating meaningful moments for her couples.

Her team was also absolutely incredible. Every single person was kind, attentive, organized and genuinely invested in making the day perfect. Together they created such a calm and joyful environment for us, our families and our guests.

Even toward the end of the night when we were exhausted, she still made sure our sparkler exit happened exactly the way we envisioned it. She paid attention to every last detail until the very end of the evening.

On top of all of that, Melissa handled complicated family dynamics with such grace, professionalism, and care. She navigated every situation flawlessly and protected the joy and peace of our day in ways we will never forget.

Other highlights include her ceremony design, which featured a spring garden-inspired floral arch that could be repurposed for our reception, helping us be efficient with our floral budget and fulfilling my wish for all the color. Going with Scheme’s full service planning package with Tara gave us 15 months of stress-free fun, a creative outlet through which my husband and I grew closer as a couple, discovering our mutual tastes and planning ways to delight our family and friends so they could enjoy the night with us after traveling cross-country and internationally for our destination wedding in Las Vegas. If Tara is available for your date, I would encourage you to meet with her! Don’t hold back on sharing your hopes and vision–as other reviews describe, you can count on Tara to provide you with choices that feel fresh and true to you and your partner. ~Discovery / packages / venue search~
Scheme stood out to us for the sheer diversity of events in their portfolio across styles, locations, cultures, and of course, couples. I was also impressed by their support of non-profits like VOW for Girls to end child marriage. Initially we reached out to Tara in December 2021 seeking day-of management, but after a great intro call with her, where we felt like she truly “got us,” we knew we wanted to book with her.

At 3 months out, Tara set up weekly touch-base calls, gently keeping us on track with a friendly nudge when needed for things like the daunting task of writing our own vows. Tara also helped us navigate the sensitive activities of building and adjusting our guest list, tracking RSVPs and fielding requests from our family on the ceremony program.

Tara and the Scheme team coordinated with the other vendors seamlessly in the background, and at the end of the ceremony, we were actually slightly ahead of schedule. Her designs are unmatched. She works with couples to truly understand what they want (even when the two partners don’t always agree themselves :P ), and design a one-of-a-kind experiences that blows their expectations out of the water. All 6 options aligned beautifully with our vision, and we can tell she put time into finding the right options for us, as opposed to throwing every business at us during this fire drill. From beginning to end…the whole process was an absolute breeze. One of the biggest reasons we chose to elope was because I didn’t want the stress that can come with planning a traditional wedding and Coralie gave us exactly that — a completely stress-free experience.

We filled out a detailed questionnaire back in October explaining our vision, style, and everything we wanted for our day and from there she truly took care of everything. We touched base a few times between then and April but the entire process felt effortless and organized. I was able to actually enjoy being engaged instead of constantly worrying about wedding planning.

Coralie turned my dream wedding into a reality. Our day felt truly magical from start to finish, and I was able to be completely hands-off and fully present the entire day. Everything was customized to exactly what I envisioned and somehow it all came together even more beautifully than I could have imagined.

Coralie coordinated absolutely everything — hair and makeup, photography, videography, transportation to the Valley of Fire, flowers, ceremony details, and so much more. She even had my bouquet delivered directly to my hotel room. Every little detail was thought out and handled perfectly.

Our ceremony at the Valley of Fire was breathtaking. It felt intimate, emotional, and so personal. Our officiant did an incredible job and made it feel like she truly knew our entire love story. The entire experience genuinely felt like a fairytale come to life.

After the ceremony, we did a photo tour through Fremont Street and downtown Las Vegas, which was such a fun and unforgettable experience. From the desert scenery to the Vegas lights, every moment was incredible. The videography was stunning, and we received SO many amazing photos. I was also shocked at how quickly everything was delivered — we received our full gallery and over 6 minute long highlight video in less than two weeks!

Every single person involved was so kind, professional, and easy to work with. Coralie’s communication throughout the entire process was amazing. She answered every single question I had, was incredibly patient with me in the beginning, and always made me feel reassured and excited instead of stressed.

One thing I also loved is how customizable everything is. You can truly make your elopement exactly what YOU want it to be — whether that’s something simple and intimate or something more elaborate. There are so many beautiful location options, add-ons, and packages, which makes the pricing flexible and accessible for so many couples.

I genuinely cannot say enough good things about Pretty Day and Coralie. She made our wedding day feel effortless, magical, and unforgettable. user_reviews:
[{"Name":"phil king","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjVplpkmcHiKDB4N_nyhxfgzAVzOJqB79yvzNpp3Y2AE45-DRg7E=s120-c-rp-mo-ba12-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Penn & Teller – Four Decades On, Still the Masters of Their Craft

Las Vegas has no shortage of magic shows, but there are only a handful of acts that have genuinely become part of the city's identity. Penn & Teller are one of them, and after seeing them live it's easy to understand why they've remained headliners for so long.

A little tip before the show: arrive early.

We'd heard that Penn will often come out before the performance to play double bass (upright bass) alongside the theatre pianist, so we made sure we got there with plenty of time to spare. Sure enough, there he was, casually playing jazz as guests arrived. It immediately set a completely different tone to the evening. Rather than hiding backstage until curtain up, he was already entertaining the audience before the show had even officially begun.

Arriving early brought another unexpected bonus too. We were moved to even better seats, proving that getting there ahead of time can definitely pay off.

Naturally, no Vegas evening is complete without a themed cocktail. The souvenir drinks were excellent, served in large 32oz collectible cups with names inspired by the show. Better still, they were priced much the same as drinks at other major Vegas attractions, so they felt like good value rather than a captive audience premium.

Then the show begins...

If you've watched Penn & Teller on television, you'll know roughly what to expect, but seeing them live is something else entirely. Every trick is performed right in front of you. There are no camera cuts, no editing, no digital effects and nowhere to hide.

The opening of the show immediately reminded us just how unique they are. For the first trick, Penn was actually standing at the end of our row, making us feel part of the performance from the very start. It was one of those wonderfully surreal "only in Vegas" moments that made an already intimate theatre feel even more personal.

One of the things I admire most is their complete honesty about what they're doing.

They repeatedly remind the audience that they perform tricks, not supernatural powers or unexplained miracles. At one point, Penn explains that the odds of selecting four particular cards are over 108,000 to one... before smiling and asking what the odds are of it happening tonight at a Penn & Teller show.

His answer?

"100%... it's a goddamn trick."

That perfectly sums up their philosophy. They don't ask you to believe in magic. They invite you to enjoy being fooled by two people who have spent over forty years becoming masters of their craft.

The humour is just as important as the tricks themselves. Penn's storytelling, Teller's perfectly timed expressions and the effortless chemistry between them carry the evening from one incredible moment to the next. The audience spends as much time laughing as they do wondering, "How on earth did they do that?"

What impressed me most, though, was their enthusiasm.

After all these years, they still look like they're genuinely enjoying every minute on stage. That energy is infectious, and it's probably one of the reasons they've become the longest-running headlining act in Las Vegas.

There are newer magic shows. There are bigger productions. There are certainly flashier theatres.

But Penn & Teller have something far more valuable: authenticity.

They've built a career not on pretending to have magical powers, but on celebrating the art of deception, sharing the joke with the audience, and somehow leaving everyone amazed anyway.

Forty years on, they're still proving exactly why they're Vegas We chose to have an unplugged ceremony, asking our guests to put their phones away because we trusted that professional-quality photos would capture our most important moments. Unfortunately, that trust was misplaced.

One of the most significant moments of the day—the bride walking down the aisle—was not adequately captured. The final gallery contains only three photos of that moment. Of those three, only one shows the bride smiling, and her father is not even looking at the camera. None of the images are print-worthy or something we would feel comfortable sharing with our future children, family, or displaying in our home. Typically, photographers take dozens of images during this moment so that a strong selection can be delivered. That expectation was not met.

Additionally, there is only one photo of us kissing at the altar, and it contains noticeable black shadowing across the image, making it unusable.

When we respectfully raised these concerns, we were initially offered access to the RAW photos and RAW video footage at no charge. Afterward, that promise was reversed, and we were told we would need to pay $250 for RAW photos and $250 for RAW video.

Below is a direct quote from Jon’s email to us:

“I’d be happy to sell you all your RAW photos for an additional $250. Same goes for your RAW video footage. That’s what we charge for RAW.

I had offered you RAW free of charge before confirming your concerns, but after reviewing everything, as I’ve already stated, I think you got a great gallery, great videos, and had an overall great experience with our team. Having a few fewer shots of very specific moments than you wanted doesn’t warrant me giving you $500 worth of free product.”

We also received thumb drives that were supposed to contain our footage, but they included only the same edited photos and videos already available in the online gallery, not the RAW files as discussed.

What made this experience especially frustrating was being told repeatedly that what we received was “great” or “average,” despite legitimate concerns about once-in-a-lifetime moments being poorly represented and unusable—after we intentionally chose an unplugged ceremony in reliance on professional coverage.

This was our wedding day. These moments cannot be recreated.

While others may have had positive experiences, ours did not reflect the level of care, accountability, or professionalism we expected for a $4,000 wedding package.

Future couples should ensure everything is clearly outlined in writing, including:

• Coverage expectations for critical moments
• Typical number of usable images delivered
• RAW file policies
• How missed or poorly captured moments are handled

Unfortunately, based on our experience, we cannot recommend this service.","Images":["https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/grass-cs/ACvplmPm0MINXYabLeT9786Sd214mf8LfC1Az0zQ4nTHgK20sJqRoJRHsgEZAh9JgbN7Qy5G6Xeem9Etop7Grba8drm2oTDOmglvjcqtse7h-zQW-1Ud3ScC59nmgpXFCkStLBPO9uzSTevMoHgS=k-no"],"When":"8 months ago","review_id":"Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xGSVprMVFlVVpHWkZscVExb3dPQzFtVFVWWk1GRRAB","source":"Google","rating_scale":5,"rating_float":1,"author_url":"https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/105596611712296845556/reviews?hl=en-GB","posted_at_unix_micros":1767601860917500,"updated_at_unix_micros":1767601860917500,"language":"en","translated_lang":"","text_original":"While the photographer and videographer were pleasant to work with on our wedding day, the final results—and how our concerns were handled afterward—were deeply disappointing, especially given that we paid around $4,000 for their wedding package.

A month ago, we were planning a destination wedding in Mexico with 80 guests. Just days before our wedding, we were faced with unexpected uncertainty that could have completely canceled everything. Within hours, we made the decision to pivot our entire wedding to Las Vegas—with only a few days to plan.

Katarina was one of the first people to reach out, and from her very first message, we knew we were in the right hands. She immediately jumped in with confidence, reassurance, and a clear plan. What felt impossible suddenly felt achievable.

In less than 72 hours, Katarina helped us plan an entire wedding from scratch. She coordinated multiple vendors, including finding our amazing photographer, managed contracts, handled logistics, and kept everything moving seamlessly—all while we were flying across the country trying to regroup with our families.

What truly sets Katarina apart is her ability to stay calm under pressure and make you feel completely supported. We had complete trust in her almost instantly, and she delivered on every single promise.

On the wedding day, she went above and beyond in every way. This was a massive undertaking with countless moving parts (e.g., invitations, wedding ceremony, cocktail hour, reception, bus logistics, invitations, entertainment, bartenders, and so much more).  Her team was excellent at coordinating boots-on-the-ground in Nevada while our "war room" was back in Texas.

We were in constant contact with her over the past month, from texts to calls to audio messages and everything in between.  The P3 team works all day, every day.

The biggest win?  Lindsay somehow secured us a spot at the Little White Wedding Chapel when none were available.  Her team's persistence and refusal to take no for an answer made it happen.  In fact, I'm convinced we couldn't have gotten married at that world-renowned location without her connections and sheer determination.  That's the Chicago in her -- and worth every penny.

You don't need a pushover as a wedding planner for your special day, you need a pit-bull... and that's Lindsay + team.

She also locked down the Hardwood Suite at the Palms Casino for our reception, which was absolutely iconic. For context, music videos are shot at this location and high-rollers stay here, yet somehow we managed to snag it for our elopement -- all thanks to P3.

Lindsay brought an impressive network of vendors and referrals for everything we needed.  If one couldn't meet our tight timeline, she'd immediately pull another (often even better) option from her arsenal.  She and her team coordinated everything: photography with Beth @ Velvet Alchemy, videography, showgirls, cocktails on buses for guests, a beautiful cocktail hour, and an unforgettable party at the Hardwood Suite with phenomenal dinner service and dancing.

She even helped us execute a surprise gender reveal at the reception that stunned all our guests, while also arranging a three-piece band with violins and an Adele singer to serenade everyone.  It was absolutely magical.

My wife and I loved that despite her team's packed schedule, especially during October wedding season, Lindsay made sure the P3 staff prioritized our event given its scale and importance.

Our guests had an amazing time and everything turned out beautifully.  The team expertly navigated any hiccups (which are inevitable in any last-minute elopement) to make our night truly special.

If you're planning a Vegas wedding, especially on short notice, Lindsay's expertise and vendor connections are invaluable.  Highly recommend P3 for making Vegas wedding dreams come true.  They operate with the intensity and precision of NYC investment bankers, but for Las Vegas wedding planning.

This was a massive undertaking with countless moving parts (e.g., invitations, wedding ceremony, cocktail hour, reception, bus logistics, invitations, entertainment, bartenders, and so much more).  Her team was excellent at coordinating boots-on-the-ground in Nevada while our "war room" was back in Texas.

We were in constant contact with her over the past month, from texts to calls to audio messages and everything in between.  The P3 team works all day, every day.

The biggest win?  Lindsay somehow secured us a spot at the Little White Wedding Chapel when none were available.  Her team's persistence and refusal to take no for an answer made it happen.  In fact, I'm convinced we couldn't have gotten married at that world-renowned location without her connections and sheer determination.  That's the Chicago in her -- and worth every penny.

You don't need a pushover as a wedding planner for your special day, you need a pit-bull... and that's Lindsay + team.

She also locked down the Hardwood Suite at the Palms Casino for our reception, which was absolutely iconic. For context, music videos are shot at this location and high-rollers stay here, yet somehow we managed to snag it for our elopement -- all thanks to P3.

Lindsay brought an impressive network of vendors and referrals for everything we needed.  If one couldn't meet our tight timeline, she'd immediately pull another (often even better) option from her arsenal.  She and her team coordinated everything: photography with Beth @ Velvet Alchemy, videography, showgirls, cocktails on buses for guests, a beautiful cocktail hour, and an unforgettable party at the Hardwood Suite with phenomenal dinner service and dancing.

She even helped us execute a surprise gender reveal at the reception that stunned all our guests, while also arranging a three-piece band with violins and an Adele singer to serenade everyone.  It was absolutely magical.

My wife and I loved that despite her team's packed schedule, especially during October wedding season, Lindsay made sure the P3 staff prioritized our event given its scale and importance.

Our guests had an amazing time and everything turned out beautifully.  The team expertly navigated any hiccups (which are inevitable in any last-minute elopement) to make our night truly special.

If you're planning a Vegas wedding, especially on short notice, Lindsay's expertise and vendor connections are invaluable.  Highly recommend P3 for making Vegas wedding dreams come true.  They operate with the intensity and precision of NYC investment bankers, but for Las Vegas wedding planning.

I cannot thank the team at Just Marry! enough for making our 21st-anniversary Disney-themed vow renewal the BEST DAY EVER! I didn't hire a planner for our original wedding, but upgrading to their full planning and day-of coordination services for this event was the best decision I ever made.
I worked mostly with Mairead, who was fantastic from start to finish. Her communication was perfect. When she went on maternity leave, she ensured a seamless handoff to Danielle, and when she returned, we jumped right back into it without missing a beat. Mairead was incredibly honest, helping with great suggestions while keeping my budget in mind by pointing out things that would just be a waste of money.
As the event got closer, she introduced me to Amanda, my on-site coordinator, who went completely above and beyond. Because I was supplying my own decor, Amanda offered to meet me right at my resort to pick everything up, ensuring it would get through venue security smoothly. She even put together a few items I had forgotten to assemble!
The night before the event, we hit a massive hiccup. Due to recent Disney policy changes regarding third-party vendors, we could no longer use our original resort for getting ready because my external media, hair, and makeup teams weren't permitted on property—despite being told months prior by a cast member that it would be fine. I had to message Amanda late that night to let her know we had to switch locations. She jumped right on it, immediately coordinating with all of my vendors to update them.
Because we ended up staying further away, we arrived a little late, and our event didn't start right on time. But Amanda and her assistant, Ellis, were absolute saints. They never made me feel rushed for a single second. They reassured me that our time at Paddlefish was secure and that no one was going to rush our event to an end.
When I walked in, the decorations took my breath away. I had given them free rein with the decor I provided, and they completely exceeded my expectations.
If you are planning an event, do yourself a favor and hire Just Marry! They are professional, honest, highly adaptive when things go wrong, and truly magical. As our wedding day approached, our guest list continued to increase from the originally planned 40 to eventually 130+. This created a ripple effect increasing the work needed from all our vendors. I have nothing but amazing things to say about Debbie and Party Perfect Orlando. We selected Debbie as our event planner for our Golden Gala 50th Anniversary Celebration and it was the best decision we could have made!!
From start to finish, Debbie was focused on creating a cohesive theme at our event and making all of our dreams come true. Debbie is a creative genius and found a way to have our theme spread to every inch of our event!
She connected us to the best vendors and then helped us manage those interactions and guided us through every aspect of the event planning journey! On the day of the event, she was there to help our vision come to life and make sure everything ran smoothly throughout the night!

We are a small non profit organization and we were so thrilled with how much effort Debbie put into to keeping us under our budget! She was constantly looking at how much we had spent and what still needed to be done and made sure that we got the best deals on vendors, decor, and entertainment without straying away from our vision. Every detail seemed thoughtfully considered, not for its own sake, but because it contributed to the experience of the couple, their families, and their guests.

As someone who spends a great deal of time observing weddings from the inside, I notice the planners who understand that the most memorable celebrations are rarely about trends or spectacle. They are about creating an environment in which people feel welcomed, cared for, and connected to one another. Michele has a remarkable gift for doing exactly that.

","reply_language":"en","reply_posted_at_unix_micros":1685219810000000,"reply_updated_at_unix_micros":1685219810000000,"published_at":"2023-05-27T03:58:33.847776Z"},{"Name":"Avonie Parchment","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjXpT0urzhLz_c7uTY9BGzJ8v-Eu4r3IkSjDAwq41kVjF3ZYxP-c=s120-c-rp-mo-ba12-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"When I first contacted Taren, my husband and I had been engaged for nearly a year with absolutely nothing decided except our colors. It wasn't that we couldn't agree on anything, it was that we both didn't want to make decisions when we weren't the professionals. Taren said that she could do everything (within reason) and that we wouldn't have to worry about anything. I immediately booked her.

Over the next few months, she short listed venues based off our interests and needs and we settled on the Highland Manor in Apopka. While it didn't have our favorite ballroom (another choice Taren gave us), it had the prettiest spot for ceremony, several rooms for us to get ready in, multiple bathrooms, multiple bars, and everything we could want for our guests (a hotel next door, peacocks on property, and a suitable place for ceremony if it rained). She even took us to Dubsdread to try out the food so we could make our decision.

She then spent a few months researching our theme. When Ren Faire season started up again, she came with us to a few to gauge her understanding of our theme and find little things that would fit in the decor. It was at one of these that she shared that she had been in talks to do something so over the top and wonderful, but because of cost and wanting what was best for the wildlife on property, decided against it. It was at this moment that we knew that our wedding was going to be perfect. Anyone who spends time with us will quickly find out that while we love a spectacle, we want everyone involved to be happy, including the animals that may be a part of that show. Taren got us!

After we had the big ticket items bought and booked, she sat down with us and explained her vision in pictures. We said yes and let her do her thing. She took care of contracts, payments, our invitations and tracking, all the decisions, everything. She asked for a bit of money to do a few surprises for us, and we agreed.

At rehearsal, she told the entire bridal party what to expect and what they needed to do to make sure the day went off without a hitch. She had us rehearse twice, told us where to go in the morning, and sent us off.

The day of the wedding, I walked into a getting ready room that looked like something straight off of pinterest: a long dining table set and decorated was in the middle, ready for lunch, we had four stations for hair and makeup, one with a plush faux fur rug for comfort, an entire tea, coffee, and mimosa station, etc. When I saw it, I started crying. I don't see myself as someone who knows how to prioritizes the esthetic (hence our need for a full service planner), and to know that my bridal party and moms would be in such a beautiful room and that they would be happy and cared for gave me such joy!

After we had hair and makeup done, Taren and our photographer and videographer whisked us to the venue next door. Taren made sure we didn't see anything and spoil the surprise. The way you showed up for us and our families, with both professionalism and genuine care, meant more than we can express. You created a space where we felt safe, celebrated, and supported in every way.
