From day one, Jessica made me feel like I was her only bride. I always felt heard, prioritized, and genuinely cared for. She took the time to understand exactly who my husband and I are and what we wanted for our wedding. She brought to life the classic, iconic New York City wedding of our dreams (beyond our dreams) at St Patrick's Cathedral and the Rainbow Room (& rehearsal dinner at Il Gattopardo)

To say Jessica Jordan is detailed-oriented would be the understatement of the century. She thinks through every logistical challenge before it ever becomes a problem, and somehow always anticipates the things you would never even think to consider. Her years in hospitality and luxury events also meant she knew exactly how to maximize our budget. She negotiated on our behalf, saved us thousands of dollars, and curated incredible vendor options for every decision. She did not rest until we were truly happy with every single vendor and decision.

Jessica never dismissed an idea as impossible. She thrives on being creative and finding a way. She has the connections, creativity, and determination to make the extraordinary happen…including surprise performances by the Rockettes and Broadway's Jersey Boys (still pinching myself).
Beyond her expertise, Jessica gave me something I didn't think would be possible during wedding planning: peace of mind. She handled family dynamics with grace, kept every moving piece under control, and made me feel calm and confident throughout the entire process.

On our wedding day, I got to luxuriate in being a bride. I was completely present because Jessica was handling absolutely everything behind the scenes. And what impressed me most was that her job didn't end when the wedding did. She coordinated with vendors, brought all of our belongings home from the venue, arranged for my wedding dress and other clothes to be sent to the dry cleaner, and took care of countless post-wedding details I never had to think about. She let me continue soaking in the joy of being newly married instead of worrying about logistics.
Jessica didn't just execute our vision—she elevated it. She is an advocate, strategist, negotiator, and problem-solver, but above all, she is someone who truly cares about her couples. Hiring Jessica was the best decision we made during our wedding planning process. Beyond a 5-star experience. Surrounded by family and friends, about to marry my best friend, is a great recipe for success, but what carried us over the finish line, with triumph, was Amy Katz and her team.

From our first meeting with Amy, we knew our wedding was in good hands. Her confidence, knowledge and years spent in the industry building and maintaining relationships, filled us with peace that Amy was the planner for us. Not only is Amy one of the top wedding planners in NYC, but she’s genuinely liked and respected by all in the industry. She’s fair and direct and gets the job done, with everyone feeling like they were taken care of and listen to.

She respects different ideas and opinions and effortlessly creates a safe space for sharing all those things openly.

One of my favorite things about Amy is her ability to problem solve. She rolls with the punch’s so to speak. With Amy in your corner you know things will turn out better than you could have even hoped or planned.

To say Amy’s team is amazing doesn’t do them justice. They are passionate about what they do. Positive, kind, thoughtful and warm. Leading up to, and on my wedding day, it felt like I was surrounded by loving friends. You feel like you are part of their family. I can honestly say that this alone made me truly feel like I was insulated from all hickupps, all things that could’ve bothered me on my wedding, because I genuinely felt protected and surrounded by loving people. Amy and her team. Their love of what they do elevates everyone and everything around them.  Words of encouragement and support, thoughtful attention to detail, to acts as small as making sure that I was drinking water to stay hydrated or a chair to sit down on in between photos. They provided a loving support that truly made my wedding day better.

One of my favorite things about working with Amy was all of her recommendations. She took time to get to know us then carefully gave us recommendations on wedding bands, Makeup Artist, Hair Stylist, and different vendors that she thought would be the best fit for me personally. I found that each of these individuals had the same level as professionalism, kindness, and thoughtfulness as Amy. It’s clear to me that someone like Amy has a special skill for finding and gathering those who care deeply and that are as equally invested to their craft as she is.

Amy Katz personifies excellence. I openly recommend her to every friend, every acquaintance, and every stranger that I hear is starting the wedding planning I attended the Wedding Salon Bridal Showcase on October 13, 2025, held at the Fairmont Miramar Hotel & Bungalows, located at 101 Wilshire Blvd, Santa Monica, CA 90401.

Venue:
The venue itself was beautiful. Every staff member from the Fairmont was pleasant and professional, which made the start of the experience enjoyable.

Vendors:
The vendors were great. There was a wide variety and I appreciated that they represented many different wedding needs and services. I truly enjoyed each one I interacted with.

Event Staff (Issue):
The real problem was with the event staff. I purchased a VIP ticket, which included a swag bag, tickets for two guests and a raffle ticket. When I checked in, none of this was mentioned — not the swag bag, not the raffle ticket. I had to ask about the sea bag shortly after checking in and I am o remembering the raffle ticket as I edit this review, nothing was mentioned at check-in.

When it was time for me to leave, I asked again at the check-in desk about the swag bag and was sent to a table in the back. Once there, I was told I needed to leave a 5-star review in order to receive it, which that should have been as this was a paid for item. As I sat waiting, I watched the same thing happen to every single guest, regardless of whether they had a general admission or VIP ticket.

After getting my bag, I went back to the front desk to clarify the situation. I was told there should have been a difference between VIP and general admission guests — but there was none. I was told that VIP tickets were supposed to be identified by a “V” on the guest wristbands, yet I did not receive any VIP indicator on my wristband. There was no apology, no correction and no accountability. I left feeling completely misled and swindled out of the extra $20 I paid for the so-called VIP experience. Every guest was given the same thing no matter what they paid. That $20 could have easily gone toward the $22 valet, which was not indicated on the website (I may have missed it, but I did not see it when I purchased my ticket).

Accessibility:
The event was also not ADA-friendly. I use a rollator and it was extremely difficult to get around. The aisles were narrow — if another guest in a wheelchair was coming the other way, one of us had to stop completely because we couldn’t pass. At check-in, I couldn’t fit in front of the registration desk and had to stand to the side and raise my voice to be heard. No one offered assistance or even thought to move the dividers to help me through. I kept running in to things due to the setup, not due to the venue itself.

Overall Experience:
While the vendors and location were beautiful, the disorganization, lack of accessibility and unethical VIP handling completely ruined the experience. It’s unacceptable to advertise something that isn’t delivered and then pressure guests for 5-star reviews in exchange for items they already paid for. [{"Name":"Denise Godel","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjWyqSbz6EIOyjGPRwOwoWK69pqHZU76Ehf_LR7WDl7--ukDz3pw=s120-c-rp-mo-ba12-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Highly recommend working with Wild Heights Events!
I worked with Willa for over a year, and she went above and beyond in every possible way — not just as a planner, but as a designer, creative partner, and calm voice that I needed throughout the process!

From the very beginning, she helped us find and select our venue, joining us for site visits and appointments, and helping us think through every logistical detail we wouldn’t have known to ask. She always makes time to chat ad hoc but keeps a regular cadence with you so you feel like you're always on track.

Her design eye is absolutely incredible — she took my scattered ideas and turned them into a cohesive, elevated, and personal vision that felt so us. One of my favorite parts of our wedding was the design concept she created around our rescue dogs. The venue is absolutely stunning and offers such a unique mix of elegance, charm, and versatility. Every part of the property photographs beautifully, from the outdoor ceremony spaces to the interior reception areas, and it provides countless opportunities for natural, timeless wedding photos throughout the day.

One of the things we appreciated most was how well the venue flows for a wedding day. Everything felt thoughtfully laid out and organized, which helps create a smoother and less stressful experience for both couples and vendors. The lighting around the property was excellent, and there were so many beautiful backdrops that made portraits feel effortless. Whether shooting wide scenic images or more intimate moments, the venue worked incredibly well from a photography standpoint.

The staff was also wonderful to work with. Everyone we interacted with was professional, friendly, organized, and accommodating throughout the day. It always makes a big difference when a venue team works well with vendors, and Pearl Mansion did an excellent job creating a welcoming and efficient environment for everyone involved. You can tell they truly care about the couple’s experience and about making the wedding day run smoothly.

The reception space had an amazing atmosphere once everything was set up and guests arrived. It felt elegant without being overly formal and created a really warm environment for celebrating. It was finally working 3 hours into the evening. Follow up from the company proved it was never turned on, despite clear and simple instructions in the box. Tina must have realized it was not turned on, but she never explained or apologized for the mistake.
8. Tina failed to keep us on the timeline that she helped create. Some was due to speeches/toasts going longer than planned (we take full responsibility for that.) Had she even thought to ask me at the conclusion of the reception I would have taken the bouquet. HUGE failure as a full wedding planner!

Our event was 130 guests, six figures and at the upper end of the price range she handles for full wedding planning (per info she provided in our initial interview.) Months later, when I reached out, she instantly remembered a DM I had sent simply complimenting her. From our very first call, I recognized her authenticity and knew she was the one.

We soaked in the day slowly and intentionally without a care because she had it all covered. We are so grateful.

[{"Name":"Whitney & Stephen","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjVNX_TpfBTmf-ja8GqcdWe48h-bLylwPx445Mkqtyns5oAqr14=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"We LOVED working with Jackie and Cookie of AboutJoy. If we could, we would give them a 10 out of 5 star rating for how much they went above and beyond for us. Even before we officially hired her, Jackie was acting like our wedding planner, and immediately began throwing out ideas that showcased our main focus for our wedding (delicious food and a beautiful outdoor venue). We could tell right from our first call that Jackie was truly excited about our vision and “got it.” From there, Jackie was a true creative/collaborative partner, and helped make our special day a reality. Jackie brought a wealth of knowledge and wisdom to our planning - while she was always encouraging of our vision and would find a way to make my crazy ideas possible, she also was quick to offer a reality check based on her extensive experience (ex: she very smartly and politely informed us that using scented candles at our reception - while trendy - would likely summon bees and might get overwhelming given all the other floral scents in the garden reception area). We almost exclusively used vendors from Jackie’s recommended list and each and every one did an absolutely stellar job. Jackie also did a phenomenal job of working with our outside vendors, and was even able to use her extensive professional network to solicit feedback on vendors we used outside of her list. She made the wedding process seamless and significantly less stressful than if we planned it ourselves, which allowed us to truly enjoy our wedding weekend and be present with our family and friends - if anything went wrong on our big day, we had no clue because About Joy had it handled!

Once we had finalized all the major items with Jackie, Cookie worked closely with us to pull together details that added a very special touch to our wedding. She custom designed and drew our wedding signage, table numbers and menus to showcase our unique tastes and personalities. We had an outdoor venue and wanted to incorporate the plant life from the venue in our wedding materials, and Cookie drew 12 separate menu covers and table numbers that highlighted this plant life, and then hid custom sketches of our dog into each table number to bring in one of the important pieces of our life to our wedding - we love the designs so much they’re going to be framed and put up in our home! Along the design journey, Cookie brought us along and solicited feedback, always taking our garbled thoughts and seamlessly translating them into a beautiful end product. She also brought so many unique ideas and suggestions to the table, including turning our escort table into a “meadow” and hiding our dog in the signage. It’s clear that Cookie is passionate about design and her excitement for our wedding specifically really helped sustain our momentum in the final months leading up to the big day.

My spouse and I both have very busy work lives and wanted to plan a wedding in less than a year, in Northern California. We started looking at venues ourselves, quickly became disillusioned with the wedding industry, and knew we needed professional help from day 0. We interviewed a bunch of planners, but Kellyne was the one we "clicked" with and had a great gut feeling about, and we were right! She helped us narrow down our venue search (we ended up choosing a venue we never would have even looked at without her), and she was there for every step of the planning process along the way.

In all our communications with Kellyne, starting with our initial interview call, Kellyne was calm, experienced, listened to us and asked us what we wanted and what we were looking for, was honest and candid in her feedback and opinions, was organized and diligent, and was responsive and thoughtful.

Kellyne is well-experienced and well-connected in the industry, and the recommendations she has are based on honest, real connections she has to vendors and past couples. Both our DJ and florist were recommended by Kellyne, and they were beyond amazing--within our price point but brought a high level of excellence. We would never have stumbled upon these vendors on our own.

Kellyne also provided practical, honest advice throughout the planning process--from how to handle inevitable family drama, to when to mail invites, and everything in between--she was a reliable, responsive sounding board for it all.

Kellyne also has an amazing eye for design, and a keen understanding of what her clients are looking for (even when they don't know it yet!). Her original ideas for table settings and design elements were exactly what we ended up going with, and everything looked stunning and felt like "us."

A wedding is kind of like the tip of an iceberg--the wedding day itself is what you see, but you don't see all the layers under the surface. Our wedding day was flawless and even better than I could have imagined. My spouse and I genuinely enjoyed our wedding and got to savor it all with our loved ones. I probably am not even aware of all the work that Kellyne and her team undertook to pull it all together, but that's what makes the hand+heart team so great--Kellyne and her team handled all the back-end logistics and made it all happen. I didn't have to worry about anything, and I had full confidence everything would be executed impeccably.

I cannot imagine planning a wedding without a professional, and there is no professional I could imagine better than Kellyne and the hand+heart team. By the end, the SLE team wasn’t just a vendor, but friends... a part of our story—people God used to make our wedding truly exceptional.

Although they are based in the Bay Area, it was really important for us to have an emcee who could communicate with our guests in Cantonese, Mandarin, and English. From our initial consultation at the end of 2024 through our wedding in April 2026, the TDE team was incredibly helpful, organized, and supportive.

Jessica was amazing with coordination and kept us on track throughout the entire planning process. She followed up on open items, answered all of our questions, and made sure nothing slipped through the cracks. TDE also provided a super helpful template for us to fill out all of our event details like song selections, bridal party entrances, family names, and scripts. They even shared a recommended timeline based on their experience, which made planning so much easier.

Because they are so familiar with Chinese wedding traditions, their attention to detail and thoughtful questions really helped us feel confident that we were not missing anything important.

On the wedding day, everything ran so smoothly. Stuart set the tone perfectly during the ceremony with romantic background music as guests arrived. Otis officiated our ceremony and seamlessly blended Cantonese and English in a way that felt natural and heartfelt. His script captured our story so well, and it honestly felt like we had known him for years.

For the reception at our second venue, Otis and Stuart arrived early to make sure everything was set up and ready to go. We especially appreciated Otis going above and beyond to help coordinate with our large and sometimes chaotic family. Since my husband and I are not fluent in Cantonese or Mandarin, having him there to help communicate throughout the event gave us so much peace of mind.

From start to finish, Otis brought great energy and kept our guests engaged the entire time. Our guests loved him, and so did we. He was also very thoughtful about the timeline, making sure we had time to eat and take a breather while still keeping everything on schedule. [{"Name":"Farzana Faisal","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocJ0kgKuuDzEG6jqICiWInPVsVBg_PhCxTrJX6QA8xO0fk2NIg=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"I felt like choosing a wedding planner was one of the hardest decisions in the wedding process. There are so many businesses in the industry, and everyone's social media is heavily curated. I spoke to 5 different wedding planners, but after my first conversation with Natalia, Matchbox Event Co instantly bumped to the top of my list for two reasons. 1 - Natalia's personality - she is charismatic, warm, kind, and empathetic. I could easily see her as someone with whom I would enjoy working. 2 - It was obvious she is an extremely hard worker, who is passionately motivated with an attention for detail. Most other planners had quick, cookie-cutter 5 min conversations with me and my fiance. But Natalia had a detailed presentation with slides, images, timelines about her entire wedding planning process, spent 30 min talking with us, and was inquisitive about our vision.

And I'm glad I went with my gut, because Natalia's first impression was consistent throughout the entire process.  From finding a venue, to contract negotiations, to picking vendors, to design details, Natalia and Matchbox Event Co service was 10/10.  We had told her our top priority for our 2 day half-South Asian wedding weekend was our guests' experience and comfort. When it came to our wedding weekend, Natalia's team provided a service that was 15/10! Our guests were so well taken care of - to this day guests are still gushing over how smooth, timely, stress-free, and FUN our wedding weekend was. And as the bride, I also had ZERO stress the entire wedding. I was so calm and chill because Natalia and her team truly had everything under control. I felt like I was just there to enjoy the party, and that's exactly what I wanted! Katie even had my go-to coffee order ready for me every morning and every afternoon, without me even asking!

If design is important for you, Natalia's design talent is exceptional. I gave her some color palette choices and a few inspiration pictures, and she took it from there and created the most beautiful wedding design. The design results were stunning. I cannot tell you how many guests have told us that this was one of the most beautiful weddings they have attended. Natalia can create unique and gorgeous designs, but still with classy, timeless vibes, and without feeling like a copy/paste from instagram weddings.

It is also clear that Natalia is very well connected to different vendors in the industry. She gave us multiple recommendations for different vendors, at different price points, and the vendors we ended up choosing from her recommendations were all phenomenal! Photo/video, DJ, hair/makeup, design etc -- we loved working with every single one of them and would highly recommend to others! Natalia was also open to working with outside vendors who I had found on my own (band, violin). Unfortunately, my experience was the opposite. Rather than alleviating stress, working with them became one of the most frustrating parts of our wedding planning process.

Communication was the biggest issue throughout our experience. Shortly after we signed our venue contract, there was a period of nearly three weeks where we heard nothing despite multiple attempts to reach out for vendor recommendations. During that time, I researched, contacted, and booked our officiant, photographer, and live guitarist myself. After I raised concerns, they suggested weekly planning calls, but several were canceled or missed by Shy and Prameet with little or no notice.

Vendor meetings were also frustrating. Shy frequently joined calls while driving or away from her computer and was unable to share documents or planning materials. I often found myself leading vendor conversations and directing the agenda despite having hired a full-service planner. During one meeting, she said she could not share our wedding timeline because she was driving, but her video briefly turned on and it appeared she was actually at home.

To be fair, many of their vendor recommendations were excellent, including Crafted Cuisine, Monroy Films, Lena's Events, Nora's Photobooth, and the Arizona Biltmore. We were very happy with those vendors. Unfortunately, their recommendation for our DJ became one of the most stressful parts of wedding planning. They strongly encouraged us to book Sohbash Khan of Cymatic Entertainment from Chicago, assuring us that travel expenses would not be an issue because he would already be in Arizona. Even at the discounted rate, his fee was more than 3x the cost of a local DJ. One week before the wedding, after we had paid him in full, he informed us that we were expected to provide him with a room at our venue. His contract never required accommodations, and neither he nor our planners had discussed this beforehand with us. Venue rooms were approximately $800/night by then. We offered to book him a nearby hotel, but he refused. Weddings by Shy negotiated a discounted rate at the venue, but we still had to pay for a room that was never part of our agreement, leaving us feeling backed into a corner days before our wedding.

Another disappointing experience involved our catering contract. Food was one of our highest priorities, and when we had concerns about the one-sided ccatering ontract, we reached out to Weddings by Shy for guidance via e-mail but received no response. After my father called Prameet multiple times, they finally discussed it in a call that ended in an argument. During a later call with the caterer, the conversation shifted away from the contract and focused on what they viewed as my father's rude behavior instead. My father left the call  very upset. I later spoke with the caterer, offered to cover their legal fees to revise the agreement, and they agreed. The matter was resolved quickly, making the earlier conflict feel entirely unnecessary.

One reason we hired Weddings by Shy was their claim that they intentionally limit the number of weddings they take on so they can provide each event with exceptional attention. Our experience did not reflect that promise. Communication delays, canceled meetings, and lack of preparation left me feeling that I had done much of the coordination myself while still paying for full-service planning.

Our wedding itself was beautiful, and we are very grateful to the talented vendors who helped make the day special. However, I can't say that Weddings by Shy made the planning process easier. If you are looking for a planner who is proactive, consistently responsive, prepared for meetings, and willing to advocate for your interests during vendor negotiations, think twice about Weddings by Shy. When the timeline was adjusted, there were discrepancies between her schedule and vendor schedules that were never identified or corrected.

Those issues created several problems on the wedding day. The DJ announced last call almost immediately after dancing began because of a timeline conflict, and one of my bridesmaids had to pay cash out of pocket to keep the bar open. My content creator missed important moments, including parent dances, because the schedule changes were not properly communicated. My husband and I also never had the opportunity to eat our desserts.

There were also basic coordination details that were missed. Our officiant was never provided our marriage certificate for signature, creating unnecessary stress after the wedding. Throughout the event, I often could not locate Keri when questions arose, which left family members, the bridal party, and vendors trying to solve issues themselves.

We are disappointed to read this review, particularly because it does not accurately reflect the extensive communication, planning, and support provided throughout your wedding journey.

Our records show months of communication through text messages, phone calls, social media messages, email, and your client portal. Your wedding timeline was reviewed together, approved, and uploaded to your client drive prior to the wedding. In fact, we continued communicating regularly and accommodating updates, including changes requested shortly before and during the wedding weekend.

While we respect that your perception of the day differs from ours, several statements made in this review are inconsistent with our documented communications, timeline approvals, and wedding-day records.

On the wedding weekend, our team worked through numerous unexpected challenges, including venue setup issues, rental complications, vendor coordination concerns, and multiple timeline adjustments. Rather than allowing those issues to impact the event, we proactively secured replacement rental items, coordinated solutions with vendors, adjusted the timeline as needed, extended services beyond our contracted responsibilities, and continued supporting you throughout the day.

Regarding the timeline, our contract does not require a meeting during the week of the wedding. However, we remained in frequent contact leading up to the event and accommodated multiple requests and revisions as they arose.

We also acknowledge that additional clarification regarding the marriage license process would have been beneficial. Because the officiant was a personal acquaintance and the license was never provided to our team, we understood that process was being handled directly between the appropriate parties. Nevertheless, we appreciate the feedback and have reviewed our procedures accordingly.

Most importantly, we stand behind the professionalism, communication, and effort our team provided before, during, and after your wedding. We have retained extensive documentation of our planning process, communications, timeline approvals, and the many actions taken on your behalf throughout the event.

While we regret that your final impression differs from our experience working together, we remain proud of the care, time, and dedication invested in making your wedding day successful and wish you and Jeff all the best.

— Keri Lugo
